'''Rii Jenks''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who [[Bartender/Legends|operated]] the [[Rii Jenks Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Jenks paid regular bribes to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] to prevent them from interfering in his business, and he also took steps to avoid coming into conflict with the various [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that operated on Formos, by offering them the use of his bar as a safe-house and storeroom.
